title: Extra Garlicky Venezuelan Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Venezuela, featuring the deep flavors of garlic and the warm spices of the Tajine. This Tagine recipe is a fusion of Thai and Latin American flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, garlic, Thai sweet basil, Horapa sauce, salt, and pepper.
Brush the inside of the Tajine with olive oil and add the chicken mixture.
Place the Tajine over medium heat on your stovetop and sear the chicken for 5 minutes on each side.
Transfer the Tajine to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the char-grill yang by mixing together the dried chili flakes and garlic powder.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and sprinkle the char-grill yang mixture over the top.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
